name: smwgraphics-icy-mountains-and-pines
title: Icy Mountains and Pines
description:
Name of ExGFX: Icy Mountains and Pines;
Foreground, Background, or Sprite?: Background (BG);
Author: Broozer;
Custom or Rip?: Custom;
Slot(s) Used?: BG1;
Palette(s): Palettes 00 and 03 (the status bar palette is NOT affected by palette 00);
Description:
I actually made this background for a side hack of mine, which is temporarely frozen, but it turned out so well that I decided to submit it to SMWC, so that everybody can use it. This BG would fit nicely in snowy/cold levels, however, they would fit in quite some other environments as well, if you tweak its palette a little bit. Sample level, palette, Map16Page file are included within the .zip file, and I highly recommend reading the readme included along with those files.

Also, if you're interested, here's a picture showing off the BG in the Bakcground Editor of Lunar Magic: Click here.

Credit is not necessary, but would be nice. Enjoy!
